advisories.summary: Telegraf 1.38.1 and Telegraf Controller 1.2.0 security release
advisories.description:
Telegraf 1.38.1 and Telegraf Controller 1.2.0 fix the following security issue.

## Go toolchain

Updated to Go 1.26.1 to fix CVE-2026-31402 (`crypto/tls`), confirmed to affect both products.

## References

- [Telegraf 1.38.1 release notes](https://docs.influxdata.com/telegraf/v1/release-notes/#v1381)

Telegraf 1.36.0 fixes the following security issue.

## Withdrawn

This advisory was published in error.
